title: Jada Toys Harry Potter Nano Metalfigs Goblet of Fire Tournament Harry Figure
descriptionText: The Jada Toys Harry Potter Nano Metalfigs Goblet of Fire Tournament Harry Figure is a collectible item inspired by the popular Harry Potter franchise. This specific figure represents Harry Potter dueling in the goblet of fire tournament, capturing a pivotal moment from the magical world of Hogwarts. With intricate details and quality craftsmanship, this toy is a must-have for any fan of the fantastical series, allowing them to bring a piece of the magical world to life in their collection.
